messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 ALERT — elevated 429 rate observed for tenant=orion in vpc-nyc-dedicated between 00:12–00:18 UTC. 429 spike correlated with burst of inference traffic from orion-prod. Aggregated 429 rate ~14% over 6m window. Paging on-call.
alex (on-call): got it, I'm on. pulling dashboards now. any customer message?
orion-admin: we started a batch re-score job at ~00:10 UTC, seeing a lot of 429s and degraded latency (p95 spiked). Some downstream retries are piling up. Not seeing failures on our side aside from 429s.
maya (sre): looking at per-tenant limits and pool saturation. vpc-nyc-dedicated has two nodes at 95% token concurrency. 429s are coming from rate limiter enforced by pool sidecar, not downstream infra. grabbing logs.
ryan (eng-runtime): can you paste the limiter logs? suspect a new request pattern with longer context triggering higher token cost per call.
maya (sre): logs snippet: ```
[00:13:21] limiter: tenant=orion token_use=42 concurrent=98/100 allow=false reason=burst_quota_exceeded
[00:13:22] limiter: tenant=orion token_use=47 concurrent=100/100 allow=false reason=burst_quota_exceeded
[00:13:25] kv-cache: hit_rate=0.12 seq_len_avg=102
```
alex (on-call): ok, that's burst quota. we need a mitigation that doesn't impact other tenants. options: 1) temp per-tenant burst increase (contract aware), 2) route orion traffic to a warm backup pool, 3) throttle non-prod jobs inside orion. which is fastest?
lina (acct-ops): small note — orion contract has a negotiated burst uplift clause but needs ops approval for manual increases >2x. don't want to violate billing/contract. we can do a short emergency uplift with customer signoff.
ryan (eng-runtime): fastest technical: route to warm-burst pool in same region. I can flip route for orion to warm-pool-2 in ~3m if capacity available. That avoids touching contract immediately.
maya (sre): warm-pool-2 currently at 60% and can absorb the extra. We'll need to update routing policy in routing-store: ``rictl route update --tenant orion --target warm-pool-2 --weight 100 --note "emergency move"``. I can run that.
alex (on-call): do it, but also create a short-lived token override as backup in case route change fails. Label it "temp-orion-burst-00:30". post rollback plan.
maya (sre): running route update now. ``> rictl route update --tenant orion --target warm-pool-2 --weight 100``
deploybot: route update accepted and propagated to edge nodes (txn=0x3f9b).
ryan (eng-runtime): verifying in logs — traffic shifting. p95 latency for orion on warm-pool-2 is nominal; 429 rate dropping to ~1.2% within 45s. good signal.
orion-admin: seeing requests succeed again, thanks team. we'll pause the rescore and retry cautious ramp.
lina (acct-ops): I'll queue a contact attempt to get explicit approval for a 2.5x temporary burst uplift for 30m. if they approve, we can annotate billing and avoid repeated routing. opening ticket #CS-19472: https://support.redwood.ai/t/CS-19472
alex (on-call): note — ensure tenancy isolation: other tenants on warm-pool-2 must not be affected. maya, can you confirm no eviction/overcommit for other tenants?
maya (sre): confirmed: routing used spare capacity; other tenants stay under 80% concurrency. added a circuit-breaker policy: if warm-pool-2 concurrent >= 90% we auto-failover back to main pool and revert route.
ryan (eng-runtime): adding a temporary per-tenant reject-sample to reduce retries from client side: ``config: tenant.orion.retry-backoff=linear(200ms) max-retries=1`` — ask orion to update if possible.
orion-admin: we can change client retry policy. deploying patch in 2m.
alex (on-call): handoff plan — I'll stay until the customer confirms after 15m stable. If it reoccurs, page night-sre. leaving a runbook note in #incidents-log.
maya (sre): postmortem checklist: capture exact token usage histogram, KV-cache miss reason, and model seq_len changes. creating internal ticket IR-2587.
lina (acct-ops): once approval comes back, I'll apply billing annotation and schedule an official uplift for the 30m window.
alex (on-call): marking current mitigations: route->warm-pool-2 (done), client retry reduced (in-flight), account ops contacting customer. status: TRIAGED -> MONITORING :white_check_mark:.
orion-admin: confirmed stable at +20m, thanks. request full writeup for RCA and any recommended prompt batching changes.
alex (on-call): will follow up with RCA tomorrow and link IR-2587 + CS-19472. handing off to maya for overnight watch in 30m. leaving thread. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
maya (sre): ack. I'll watch until 06:00 UTC and escalate if anything spikes. :white_check_mark:
